C. The approach begins by extracting the face from the portrait, ensure a focus on subject. Then an image recognition model generates descriptive prompts, etc. They mention Flux, reactor face-swapping, then SDXL and ControlNet. This seems quite different, not part of this repo.

D. StoryMaker merges conditional information based on facial identity and cropped character images ( Including clothing, hairstyles, bodies). Specifically, we use Position-Aware Perceiver Resampler (PPR) to integrate facial identity information with cropped character images; enabling acquisition of diverse character features.

So the repo uses position-aware perceiver resampler (PPR). Faceid_plus uses a perceiver and resampler. In the faceid_plus constructor, self.proj, self.norm, etc, then "self.pos_embed" param. Then "self.proj_out". This seems similar to "Position-Aware Perceiver Resampler". Additional code that uses "pos_embed" likely provides positional awareness. It's used in the repo.
